Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxSafehouseClaims_: Maximum number of safehouses a single player can own. (1-5)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxVehicleClaims_to: Maximum number of vehicles a single player can claim. (1-10)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_SafehouseExpiration: Safehouses are automatically released after this many real days of owner inactivity. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_VehicleExpirationDa: Claimed vehicles are automatically released after this many real days without owner interaction. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxClaimPadding_too: Maximum padding tiles a player can choose when claiming a safehouse. Players select their padding in 2-tile increments up to this value. (2-16)
